name: blightbeetle_stolen_protects_its_new_controllers_creatures_from_nothing
notes: RED on the current engine (an engine fault, not a G3 kill). Printed: 'Creatures your opponents control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.' 'Your' is Blightbeetle's controller NOW (CR 109.5). Seat 1 steals Blightbeetle with Act of Treason; then seat 1's Sorin +1 targets seat 1's own Vampire, which is not a creature an opponent of Blightbeetle's controller controls: the +1/+1 counter is put on it (3/3).
